_meta.one_fact_one_home: independence_class is the string ladder I0..I5 in every schema that carries it (claim card, evidence relation, review report, citation card, kg edge). Any 0-5 ordinal is a derived mapping computed in the kernel only, never a second schema-level field.

bounded_i2_i4_exception.rule: A scholar reaching only one vendor may publish at K1 only with I2 plus an I4 mechanical/original-record check, carrying D-SAME-VENDOR and independent_check.expires_at <= 90 days from date. After expiry, either an I3+ route replaces it or the card drops to K0.

local_model_dvp_route.rule: A local-model route counts as I3 only when its model family is vendor-distinct from every other route in the set; otherwise it is treated as I2.

orthogonal_role_not_on_ladder.definition: Release authority, never a verification level.
orthogonal_role_not_on_ladder.cannot_raise: Never substitutes for I5 as a check

_meta.ordering_rule: The maximum claim tier a route set can support is bounded by the highest independence level actually reached, never by the count of routes at a lower level (ManyModels ⇏ Independence, NC-31).

independence_ladder.name: Self
independence_ladder.definition: Same session re-reads its own output.

independence_ladder.name: Same vendor, other model
can_raise: One DVP route toward L2's >=3 minimum; part of the bounded I2+I4 exception
cannot_raise: K1 floor alone (I3+ or the bounded exception required)
independence_ladder.k_ceiling: K0 -> K1 only combined with I3+, or the bounded I2+I4 exception

independence_ladder.name: Different vendor
can_raise: Founder-set minimum bar for K1 public-provisional — a minimum, never sufficient alone (Bounded-Judge Law)
finite_diagnostic/Dr where routes reproduce a mechanical result
independence_ladder.note: I3 is the K1 floor per §2.2/§6.4; never sufficient by itself.

independence_ladder.name: Mechanical / original-record
independence_ladder.definition: Proof kernel, executed test, schema validator, direct original-source lookup.
can_raise: paired with I2 under the bounded I2+I4 exception

independence_ladder.name: Independent external human (non-founder)
independence_ladder.definition: A person outside this session's authorship.
can_raise: The only route to K2 (and, with formal/empirical constraint, K3)
